primary_study.title: Tissue Depletion of Taurine Accelerates Skeletal Muscle Senescence and Leads to Early Death in Mice
primary_study.model: C57BL/6-background TauTKO mice and littermate WT/heterozygous controls on standard chow and water; young ~3 months and aged ~17-22 months.

arms.role: Partial-genotype comparator; pooled with WT in sex-specific survival comparisons

findings.scope: Genotype comparison, not taurine supplementation benefit.

findings.interpretation: Not statistically significant at the paper criterion; not proof of no biological effect.

findings.result: Marked p16Ink4a RNA increase and more central-nucleated fibers in older TauTKO; female S1 changes also present but smaller.
findings.scope: Cell-state and histological outcomes, not measured force or productive renewal.

findings.result: Lower complex I activity in aged TauTKO muscle; other tested respiratory-complex activities not significantly different. Young complex activities reported unchanged, data not shown.
findings.scope: Biochemical functional endpoint, not whole-muscle contractile output.

findings.result: Higher Grp78 protein, XBP1 RNA/spliced RNA and nuclear XBP1 signal support an unfolded-protein-response association.
findings.scope: Misfolding-to-aging mechanism remains a hypothesis; no rescue arm establishes causal mediation.

findings.result: No increase detected in S1 Gomori trichrome panels.

primary_study.functional_readout_boundary: This paper does not newly measure taurine-treatment force, grip, running or endurance. Exercise intolerance and earlier muscle-size findings are cited from previous knockout work.
primary_study.BUB1B_connection: BubR1 occurs in discussion as background on a separate p16-cell-clearance study, not as this paper's genotype, measured BUBR1 RNA/protein or taurine-response endpoint.
primary_study.causal_limit: Whole-body transporter loss establishes dependence on taurine homeostasis/transport in this model; without replacement or tissue-specific rescue it does not prove that extra taurine is sufficient in a transporter-competent BUB1B model or identify the tissue causing death.
source_issues: The ~520-day analysis prints chi-square 5.99 with P=.00054, an internally discordant pair under the ordinary stated log-rank framing; no corrected inferential value is invented.
Figure 2A appears to mark liver p16 with a significance star while Results text says liver p16 is unchanged. This unresolved secondary-tissue discrepancy is not used to rank the route.
Microarray IPA predictions are not administered compounds or demonstrated pathway interventions; no raw-data replay performed.

one_direct_treatment_followup.selection_reason: Direct reference 54 in the read TauT paper; one actual-treatment skeletal-muscle physiology source, no further citation expansion.
one_direct_treatment_followup.title: Chronic administration of taurine to aged rats improves the electrical and contractile properties of skeletal muscle fibers
one_direct_treatment_followup.model: Male Wistar rats; publisher snippet says 10 adult (6-month) and 18 older (22-month at start), across four groups. Abstract describes ~25-month animals at assessment.

intervention.dose_scope: Reported animal experiment only; no human/child conversion or recommendation.

one_direct_treatment_followup.controls: Untreated aged and adult comparator conditions described; full allocation/randomization/masking and per-group/per-animal endpoint counts unavailable at read scope.
actual_treatment_positives: Higher muscle taurine toward adult levels.
Increased resting chloride conductance and improved related threshold-current/latency measures; no conductance equivalence claim.
Restored responses to a chloride-channel ligand and PKC-modulating assay probe.
Contraction voltage threshold shifted toward adult values in isolated EDL fibers.
nulls_in_accessible_publisher_snippet: No change in food consumption or body-weight gain attributed to taurine.
No deaths in treated or untreated aged rats during the study; this is not a demonstrated survival benefit.
one_direct_treatment_followup.endpoint_limit: Excitation-contraction threshold and electrophysiology are functional physiology, but do not establish greater absolute force, endurance, productive progenitors, fidelity or MVA benefit.
one_direct_treatment_followup.BUBR1_evidence: No BUBR1 response is established by the read abstract/snippets; full-body absence was not verified.
one_direct_treatment_followup.access_and_depth: Complete primary abstract and publisher Methods/Results/Discussion snippets read. Publisher fulltext retrieval returned403; author repository has no attached file; indexed institutional PDF retrieval returned403. No native figures, complete methods/tables or full-paper credit.
one_direct_treatment_followup.remaining_gap: Complete treatment paper with decisive figures/tables, per-group animal counts and inference units remains needed before high-confidence appraisal of its effect sizes.

publication_status: publication-status.json records fresh Europe PMC core/PubMed checks on 2026-09-23: no indexed retraction/correction notices observed for either selected paper. Not an exhaustive integrity audit.

comparative_assessment.positive_credit: The genetic study makes taurine homeostasis biologically relevant to muscle aging; the one cited actual-treatment source adds electrical/excitation-contraction improvement rather than only a molecular marker.
comparative_assessment.not_transferred: Knockout lifespan and pathology cannot be assigned to taurine supplementation; neither study establishes BUBR1 stabilization or MVA rescue.
comparative_assessment.equal_standard: Different species/model alone does not exclude this hypothesis. Niacin's restoration bridge also spans interventions and apitegromab's function evidence is in another disease. Taurine lacks demonstrated absolute muscle output and relevant-genotype rescue at this read scope, while its treatment primary is incompletely accessible.
comparative_assessment.decision: Retain a muscle-physiology comparator/reserve with an access-limited treatment signal; no supported superiority or replacement of the provisional nominees.
